title: MacroPulse Alert
message:
Kospi +18% all-time record close (Samsung +28%, SK Hynix +30%) — AI chip reversal; largest single-day Kospi gain in history.
S&P 500 7,490 (+0.70%) and Nasdaq 25,374 (+1.00%) both hit record closes end of month.
Open USD (OUSD) institutional stablecoin — Visa, Mastercard, BlackRock, 140+ firms — confirmed launching on Ethereum.
